title: I started taking the elevator in my building at night. Someone keeps pressing the button for a floor that doesn't exist.
story:
My building has eleven floors. The panel has twelve buttons. The twelfth has no label and I always assumed it was the roof.

Last Monday I rode up alone at 12:30 AM and the twelfth button was already lit.

I pressed my floor. The elevator passed it without slowing. The doors opened on a hallway that looked like mine, same carpet, same flickering light, but every door was painted shut.

The doors closed on their own. I tried again the next night. The same thing, except this time one door was open a crack. A lamp was on inside.

On Wednesday I stood in the lobby and watched the numbers. Eleven. Twelve. Twelve. It was coming down, and the display said twelve for a long time.

The doors opened. The elevator was empty, but the button for my floor was already pressed. So was the twelfth.

A note was taped inside, in handwriting I know. My own. It said, Don't get in with whoever lives in 1204.

I looked back at the lobby.

My neighbor was standing there, smiling, with my keys.
premise: elevator with an unlabeled twelfth floor; the narrator's own handwritten warning; a neighbor holds the keys
